meta.description:
Camaree, app notes 9: email the client when FTG makes an Internal Upload, and email FTG (accounting@financetherapygroup.com) when a client uploads.

The app calls the webhook once per upload batch, so ten files make one email.

Before this runs:
  • Microsoft Outlook credential — signed in as accounting@financetherapygroup.com
  • Supabase credential — the service role key, as the documents flow uses
  • Activate it. The production URL must be .../webhook/ftg-upload-email, which is what the app calls.
